description: This file defines classes for configuring VNC (Virtual Network Computing) options in a kickstart installation process, including support for different Red Hat and Fedora versions. It includes classes for different versions (FC3, FC6, F9, RHEL10, F43) with methods to parse arguments and generate command strings for VNC setup.

classes.name: FC3_Vnc
classes.description: VNC configuration class for Fedora Core 3, allowing remote graphical installation via VNC with options for connect and password.

classes.name: FC6_Vnc
classes.description: VNC configuration class for Fedora Core 6, extending FC3_Vnc with support for host and port options.

classes.name: F9_Vnc
classes.description: VNC configuration class for Fedora 9, extending FC6_Vnc with support for removing the connect argument.

classes.name: RHEL10_Vnc
classes.description: Deprecated VNC class for RHEL 10, suggesting use of 'inst.rdp' instead.

classes.name: F43_Vnc
classes.description: VNC class for F43, extending RHEL10_Vnc with deprecated message.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for each class, initializing VNC options based on version and parameters.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: Generates the command string for starting VNC with current options.

methods.name: _getParser
methods.description: Creates and returns an argument parser configured with version-specific options.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to set VNC options.
